ctgov.note: No registered ClinicalTrials.gov studies under this sponsor.

commercial_product.note: SS Innovations is a surgical robotics company; products are medical devices, not drugs. Lead product SSi Mantra is approved by India's CDSCO and commercially launched in India since late 2022.
marketed: SSi Mantra Surgical Robotic System (CDSCO approved India; >7,800 surgical procedures performed)
Telesurgery / teleproctoring (CDSCO approved; >120 telesurgeries completed including world-first robotic cardiac telesurgery)
regulatory_in_progress: 510(k) premarket notification submitted to US FDA on December 5, 2025 for SSi Mantra (general, urological, colorectal, gynecological, cardiac surgery indications)
EU CE mark application submitted; FDA approval and EU certification anticipated 2026
instruments_under_development: NADI Automated Coronary Anastomotic Connector (cardiac bypass)
SSi Maya digital platform (SSi Guru, XR Cognitive Skill Simulator, AR Smart Glasses)

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Surgical robotics medical-device company (SSi Mantra). No proprietary drug pipeline. Regulatory pathway is 510(k) (submitted to FDA December 2025), not a P1/P2/P3 IND/IDE pivotal study. No active company-sponsored P1/P2/P3 clinical trials registered on ClinicalTrials.gov.
